agents.name: invoice-extractor
agents.description: Extracts header fields and line items from invoice PDFs and images.

capabilities.name: Extract fields
capabilities.description: Reads supplier, dates, totals and tax from an invoice.

capabilities.name: Extract line items
capabilities.description: Returns each line item with quantity, unit price and amount.

agents.name: currency-converter
agents.description: Converts amounts between currencies at the day's reference rate.

capabilities.name: Convert
capabilities.description: Converts an amount from one ISO 4217 currency to another.

capabilities.name: Rate lookup
capabilities.description: Returns the reference rate for a currency pair on a date.

agents.name: approval-router
agents.description: Routes an extracted invoice to the right approver by amount and cost centre.

capabilities.name: Route for approval
capabilities.description: Chooses an approver and opens an approval task.
